E0333

A chained comparison changes direction (`a < b > c`) (D-CHAINCMP1)

What

A chained comparison changes direction (`a < b > c`) (D-CHAINCMP1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0333

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0333: tests/ui/chained_comparison_mixed_direction.stderr.

Error [E0333]: this comparison chain changes direction
  --> tests/ui/chained_comparison_mixed_direction.jet:5:14
    |
  5 |     if a < b > c {
    |              ^
 Why: a chain like `0 <= sev < 10` reads in one direction; mixing `<` and `>` in one chain is almost always a mistake and has no single meaning
 Fix: split it into two comparisons joined with `&&`
